One important travel tip: These wall chargers have US-style plugs, not necessarily interchangeable international plugs. Bring a plug-shape adapter for destinations with different outlets. Also, the advertised wattage is not available at every port simultaneously; power is shared across connected devices.

My verdict: Choose the UGREEN Nexode 100W if you regularly charge three or four devices. Choose the Anker Prime 67W if you value a smaller, lighter charger more than the extra port.
